@graph.name: Bundle Palletizer
@graph.description: A bundle palletizer is a robotic system that stacks bundles, such as shrink-wrapped multipacks or strapped stacks of paper and packaging, onto pallets in stable layers, using tooling that supports soft, flexible loads. TRF Industrial Automation builds bundle palletizers on TRFCobot, TRFCompact and TRFSpeed, or as a custom palletizer, and the right model is defined by your line setup and speed.

mainEntity.name: Can One Palletizer Handle Different Bundle Sizes and Pallet Patterns?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, within the validated application. TRF palletizing platforms run multiple recipes and pallet patterns, so the same bundle palletizer can handle several bundle sizes and patterns, selected by the operator at changeover. Each size is validated with its end-of-arm tool and pattern during project engineering, and very different formats, such as film bundles and strapped bundles on one line, may need separate tools.

mainEntity.name: What Payload Does a Palletizing Robot Need for Heavy Multipacks?

acceptedAnswer.text: The robot must carry the bundle plus the end-of-arm tool, and for multipick, the combined weight of the bundles. Published case weights are up to about 22 lb for TRFCobot, 44 lb for TRFCompact and 66 lb for TRFSpeed. TRF validates the payload with your heaviest bundle and evaluates a custom palletizer when the bundle is heavier than that range.

mainEntity.name: Can One Bundle Palletizer Serve Several Bundling Lines?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, when the combined rate and the layout fit. TRFSpeed is built to consolidate the flow of multiple production lines into one coordinated palletizing system, and its modular design lets a project start as a dedicated cell and grow into a centralized palletizing area. Combined rate, bundle mix and conveyor routing are validated in the application review.

mainEntity.name: Can a Bundle Palletizer Be Integrated With My Shrink Bundler, Conveyors and Wrapper?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. TRF engineers the bundler or strapper outfeed, the cooling and accumulation conveyors, the palletizer, wrapping and labeling as one system. TRFIntraflow provides modules for conveying, accumulation, routing and elevation, and end-of-line integration puts the whole flow under one partner, from layout to startup.

mainEntity.name: Can a Bundle Palletizer Handle Strapped Paper and Packaging Bundles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, within the platform ranges or as a custom palletizer. Strapped bundles of paper products, paperboard or blanks are rigid but heavy and sensitive to edge damage, so the end-of-arm tool spreads the pressure and keeps straps intact. When a bundle is heavier or larger than the platform ranges allow, TRF evaluates a custom palletizer after validation.

mainEntity.name: How Much Does a Bundle Palletizer Cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on the platform, bundle rate, bundle weight, end-of-arm tool, pallet and sheet handling and conveyor integration. As a reference, list prices are US$ 120,000 for the TRFCobot Dual, US$ 180,000 for the TRFCompact Dual and US$ 350,000 for the TRFSpeed 100, EX Works Lenexa, Kansas, installation not included. The robotic palletizer cost page explains each factor.

mainEntity.name: What Information Should I Prepare to Size a Bundle Palletizer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bring your bundle types, dimensions and weights, film or strap details, the bundle rate at peak, shifts per day, the number of lines, your pallet size and target height, and a drawing of the end of the line. A TRF Sales Engineer uses this data to screen TRFCobot, TRFCompact, TRFSpeed or a custom palletizer, and the payback calculator gives you a first estimate.
